name: New industry uses for quantum computing

trend.summary: From 2020 to 2024, IonQ's documents increasingly emphasize customer demand and product availability, highlighting milestones such as the introduction of Algorithmic Qubits as a benchmark in 2020, plans for modular quantum computers by 2023, and expanding access to hardware and services by 2024. Key figures include 72 usable algorithmic qubits needed to challenge classical computers (2021) and IonQ's latest system with 25 algorithmic qubits (2023). The company also expanded its international presence and professional services to support customer applications.

trend.theme: IonQ technical roadmap and R&D milestones
trend.summary: From 2021 to 2024, IonQ's technical roadmap and R&D milestones emphasize advancing quantum computing to achieve broad quantum advantage and scalability. Key milestones include the 2022 launch of IonQ Aria, the world's most powerful quantum computer, and ongoing efforts to improve performance, scale, and system manufacturing. IonQ aims to solve complex problems and transform industries, with a growing focus on enterprise market applications by 2024.

trend.summary: From 2020 to 2024, IonQ's documents increasingly emphasize customer demand and product availability, highlighting milestones such as the introduction of Algorithmic Qubits as a benchmark in 2020, plans for modular quantum computers by 2023, and expanding access to hardware and services by 2024. Key figures include 72 usable algorithmic qubits needed to challenge classical computers (2021) and IonQ's latest system with 25 algorithmic qubits (2023). The company also expanded its international presence and professional services to support customer applications.

trend.theme: IonQ technical roadmap and R&D milestones
trend.summary: From 2021 to 2024, IonQ's technical roadmap and R&D milestones emphasize advancing quantum computing to achieve broad quantum advantage and scalability. Key milestones include the 2022 launch of IonQ Aria, the world's most powerful quantum computer, and ongoing efforts to improve performance, scale, and system manufacturing. IonQ aims to solve complex problems and transform industries, with a growing focus on enterprise market applications by 2024.

trend.summary: From 2020 to 2024, IonQ's documents increasingly emphasize customer demand and product availability, highlighting milestones such as the introduction of Algorithmic Qubits as a benchmark in 2020, plans for modular quantum computers by 2023, and expanding access to hardware and services by 2024. Key figures include 72 usable algorithmic qubits needed to challenge classical computers (2021) and IonQ's latest system with 25 algorithmic qubits (2023). The company also expanded its international presence and professional services to support customer applications.

From 2020 to early 2024, IonQ has steadily expanded its quantum computing cloud services, making its quantum computers accessible via all major cloud providers including Amazon Braket, Microsoft Azure Quantum, and Google Cloud Marketplace. Usage and availability have grown significantly, with IonQ being the only company offering access across all three major platforms by 2021 and continuing to enhance cloud access features and partnerships through 2024.

trend.theme: IonQ technical roadmap and R&D milestones
trend.summary: From 2021 to 2024, IonQ's technical roadmap and R&D milestones emphasize advancing quantum computing to achieve broad quantum advantage and scalability. Key milestones include the 2022 launch of IonQ Aria, the world's most powerful quantum computer, and ongoing efforts to improve performance, scale, and system manufacturing. IonQ aims to solve complex problems and transform industries, with a growing focus on enterprise market applications by 2024.

From 2020 to early 2024, IonQ has steadily expanded its quantum computing cloud services, making its quantum computers accessible via all major cloud providers including Amazon Braket, Microsoft Azure Quantum, and Google Cloud Marketplace. Usage and availability have grown significantly, with IonQ being the only company offering access across all three major platforms by 2021 and continuing to enhance cloud access features and partnerships through 2024.

trend.summary: From 2020 to 2024, IonQ's documents increasingly emphasize customer demand and product availability, highlighting milestones such as the introduction of Algorithmic Qubits as a benchmark in 2020, plans for modular quantum computers by 2023, and expanding access to hardware and services by 2024. Key figures include 72 usable algorithmic qubits needed to challenge classical computers (2021) and IonQ's latest system with 25 algorithmic qubits (2023). The company also expanded its international presence and professional services to support customer applications.

From 2020 to early 2024, IonQ has steadily expanded its quantum computing cloud services, making its quantum computers accessible via all major cloud providers including Amazon Braket, Microsoft Azure Quantum, and Google Cloud Marketplace. Usage and availability have grown significantly, with IonQ being the only company offering access across all three major platforms by 2021 and continuing to enhance cloud access features and partnerships through 2024.

trend.summary: From 2020 to 2024, IonQ's documents increasingly emphasize customer demand and product availability, highlighting milestones such as the introduction of Algorithmic Qubits as a benchmark in 2020, plans for modular quantum computers by 2023, and expanding access to hardware and services by 2024. Key figures include 72 usable algorithmic qubits needed to challenge classical computers (2021) and IonQ's latest system with 25 algorithmic qubits (2023). The company also expanded its international presence and professional services to support customer applications.

From 2020 to early 2024, IonQ has steadily expanded its quantum computing cloud services, making its quantum computers accessible via all major cloud providers including Amazon Braket, Microsoft Azure Quantum, and Google Cloud Marketplace. Usage and availability have grown significantly, with IonQ being the only company offering access across all three major platforms by 2021 and continuing to enhance cloud access features and partnerships through 2024.

trend.summary: From 2020 to 2024, IonQ's documents increasingly emphasize customer demand and product availability, highlighting milestones such as the introduction of Algorithmic Qubits as a benchmark in 2020, plans for modular quantum computers by 2023, and expanding access to hardware and services by 2024. Key figures include 72 usable algorithmic qubits needed to challenge classical computers (2021) and IonQ's latest system with 25 algorithmic qubits (2023). The company also expanded its international presence and professional services to support customer applications.

From 2020 to early 2024, IonQ has steadily expanded its quantum computing cloud services, making its quantum computers accessible via all major cloud providers including Amazon Braket, Microsoft Azure Quantum, and Google Cloud Marketplace. Usage and availability have grown significantly, with IonQ being the only company offering access across all three major platforms by 2021 and continuing to enhance cloud access features and partnerships through 2024.

trend.summary: From 2020 to 2024, IonQ's documents increasingly emphasize customer demand and product availability, highlighting milestones such as the introduction of Algorithmic Qubits as a benchmark in 2020, plans for modular quantum computers by 2023, and expanding access to hardware and services by 2024. Key figures include 72 usable algorithmic qubits needed to challenge classical computers (2021) and IonQ's latest system with 25 algorithmic qubits (2023). The company also expanded its international presence and professional services to support customer applications.

From 2021 to 2024, IonQ has emphasized the critical importance of intellectual property licensing, particularly licensing foundational patents from the University of Maryland and Duke University. The company maintains a powerful and expanding patent portfolio, viewing it as a significant barrier to entry and a future monetization source. IonQ continues to drive innovation and seeks intellectual property protection to strengthen its proprietary technology position, with a noted backlog of invention disclosures in 2024.
